title: Annual resident population estimates, states, DC and Puerto Rico (Vintage 2025)
limitations: Published Census Bureau population estimates are not exact enumeration counts.
Vintage 2025 supersedes prior vintages for comparable time series; revisions should not be silently merged across vintages.
Counts are totals, not population-normalized rates; raw-count choropleths can be misleading when comparing states.
No 2020 Decennial Census rate is inferred from these estimates.
